title: panic(...) from smithers:exceptions charges the distinguished checked panic channel of the enclosing function
notes: specification/failures.mdx, 'Foreign Exceptions': 'panic is imported from smithers:exceptions and accepts an optional message or underlying Error.' docs/DECISIONS.md 'Typed failures' (Locked) says the same. The panic must be visible in the declared Result<string, Panic> channel and reach the caller's match error branch rather than escaping as an untyped throw.
